title: fft correlation
explanation:
### Description

Perform correlation in frequency domain using FFT multiply and inverse FFT.

**input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → output**

- [vtkImageActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageActor.html) — image actor.
- [vtkImageCanvasSource2D](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageCanvasSource2D.html) — image canvas source2d.
- [vtkImageConstantPad](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageConstantPad.html) — pads an image with a constant value.
- [vtkImageExtractComponents](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageExtractComponents.html) — extracts selected components from multi-component image data.
- [vtkImageFFT](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageFFT.html) — image fft.
- [vtkImageMathematics](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageMathematics.html) — performs mathematical operations on image data.
- [vtkImageRFFT](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageRFFT.html) — image rfft.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
